page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, lines running top to bottom; a marginal note "Stwol." (Swol.) beside one line on the right; running head at the top; page number at the top left; catchword "Bercola" at the foot left; signature "R 3" at the foot centre; a printed mark "VI" at the lower right.

p.i: Bercola procedit, trini praedatur & amnis Flumina, prolabens ductile flectit iter. Praesulis acceptat Ludgeri postea rivum Nomina de pateo Praesulis ipse capit. Bercola fortitur quod dat Vorlonia flumen Ista Monasteri clade notatur humus. Bercola collecto rapitur dum latius amne Ex alia ruris parte receptat aquam, Illa sed exurgens Hamerani prodita campo Vndisona Castrum devenerator ope, Eruta metitur castrensis rudera fossa Hic geminas uno circulat amne molas, Flumine Luthenas rigno perfertur, & illic Talibus augeri Bercola gestit aquis, Sed non ante fuit, fertur quod Bercola nomen, Nomen at incertum contulit ora loci. Dum tot colligitur rivis, tot flumina passim Digerit, arrepto clarior amne fluit. Excipit herbosò Coessfeldia jugere flumen, Vrbs veteri credit numen inesse cruci, Bercola pralustri simulac defecit ab urbe Gescareae cursu tentat adire casas. Statlonium latopetitur torrente, Vredenā Ingenua pollens virginitate subit, Bercola fragmentum deferta praeterit arcis, Arcis & antiqua rudera purgat aquis, Praeterit Eyburgum, Berclovi praeterit adeit Flumina Grollorum limite ducta rapit. Moenia Lochemi, Galilaea culmina linquit Pendere laffatur fluminis inde sui. Omnibus occurrit Zuitphenia viribus amni Bercola dum Zephyri partibus urget iter. Pronus ab urbe cadit qua sternitur Isala ponte Longius amisso desinit amne vehi. Viginti stadiis simulac Zutphenia quinque Et totidem retro grande peregit iter. Fluminis Imperium Daventria pontibus arctat Mercibus Emporium sustinet arte scholas, Isala paulatim dexter diverit ab Arcto Nubifer hunc gelido Cirrius Orbe capit. Leva Tuoldenum discedit Welsenaleavam (Stwol.) Occupat Olstannum surgere dextra notat. Vrgionam dextra simulac deprendit abisse Isala Vesreniam cernere leva potest. Griftius Hulsborg; deduxit jugere flumen, Et varie lect; flumen adauget aquis.

main_text.p: (Stwol.) Note in the right margin beside the line "Leva Tuoldenum discedit Welsena levam".

page.notes: The right-margin note "Stwol." is printed beside the line "Leva Tuoldenum discedit Welsenalevam"; its position is approximate. Several words in the verse are doubtful due to the blurred scan and show-through from the reverse; the transcription of the lines is provisional. Marks "[?]" are not placed on each doubtful word because of the overall poor legibility. The final "VI" at lower right is a printed mark and is not part of the text.
